items.question: Which additional goddesses are included among the sword-bearing, skull-garlanded deities?
premises: The preceding verses describe goddesses bearing swords and skull garlands.
Māheśvarī and Cāmuṇḍā are named as members of this group.
Kaumārī and Aparājitā are also named as members of this group.
items.inference: Māheśvarī, Cāmuṇḍā, Kaumārī, and Aparājitā belong to the same group of sword-bearing, skull-garlanded goddesses.
items.plain_english: And Māheśvarī, Cāmuṇḍā, Kaumārī, and Aparājitā.
